product-detail.description_en: Look up Amazon US product details by ASIN, including the title, brand, category, listing date, price, Best Sellers Rank (BSR), monthly purchase lower bound and ratings.

review-search.description_zh: 查看指定商品所属父体的买家评论原文，可按日期、星级或有用票数筛选。
review-search.description_en: Retrieve individual stored buyer reviews and returned tags for a specified ASIN, with date, star and other supported filters.

Find the five most helpful reviews for [ASIN].

product-live.description_zh: 获取指定 ASIN 当前页面的报价、规格或五点原文。
product-live.description_en: Retrieve the current offer, specifications or selling-point text for a named ASIN.

product-discovery.description_zh: 按确认的用途、关键词或类目查找符合条件的商品。
product-discovery.description_en: Find products for a specified use, keyword or category under confirmed filters.

product-history.description_zh: 查看指定 ASIN 在所选期间的价格、类目排名或页面变化。
product-history.description_en: Track an ASIN’s observed prices, category ranks or page changes over a specified period.

category-lookup.description_zh: 按类目名称或路径查找对应类目编号。
category-lookup.description_en: Resolve a category name or path to the appropriate category ID.

market-profile.description_zh: 查看指定类目的整体需求和头部商品表现。
market-profile.description_en: Compare category-wide demand and the leading-product sample for a named market.

market-price-distribution.description_zh: 比较同一类目样本在各价格区间的商品与销量分布。
market-price-distribution.description_en: Compare the distribution of products and sales across a category’s price bands.

review-live.description_zh: 读取指定商品页面当前展示的评论。
review-live.description_en: Read the latest reviews displayed on a named product page.

traffic-structure.description_zh: 比较指定商品的自然搜索曝光和广告曝光。
traffic-structure.description_en: Compare organic and sponsored exposure for the selected ASINs.

traffic-trend.description_zh: 查看指定商品在所选期间的曝光趋势与波动。
traffic-trend.description_en: Inspect exposure direction and volatility over the requested windows.

traffic-weeks.description_zh: 查看指定商品每周的曝光及展示位置指标。
traffic-weeks.description_en: Read weekly exposure and placement measures for selected ASINs.

traffic-terms.description_zh: 查询指定期间为商品带来曝光的搜索词及其贡献。
traffic-terms.description_en: Identify the queries contributing exposure to an ASIN for the selected period.

traffic-term-weeks.display_name_en: Weekly ASIN and query visibility · ZooData
traffic-term-weeks.description_zh: 比较商品在指定搜索词下每周的曝光、位置和搜索需求。
traffic-term-weeks.description_en: Compare one ASIN’s weekly exposure and position with demand for the named queries.

query-weeks.description_zh: 查看指定搜索词每周的搜索量或 ABA 排名。
query-weeks.description_en: Read weekly search volume or ABA rank for specified queries.

search-placements.description_zh: 查看指定商品在某个搜索词下的展示位置。
search-placements.description_en: Locate named products in the observed search positions for a specified query.

product-review-profile.description_zh: 按一个或多个 ASIN 查询商品评价画像，包括买家抱怨、好评、改进诉求及其提及率。
product-review-profile.description_en: Retrieve an aggregate review profile for one or more Amazon US ASINs, including problems, praise, requested improvements and mention rates.

market-review-profile.description_en: Retrieve an Amazon US category review profile covering use cases, purchase drivers, buyer complaints and requested improvements.

product-competitors.description_zh: 匹配到的商品 ASIN、属性和取得的对比指标。
product-competitors.description_en: Matching ASINs, their attributes and the observed comparison measures.

market-rating-distributions.description_zh: 星级分布，按指定类目及样本展示。
market-rating-distributions.description_en: Star-rating distribution for the specified category sample.

market-rating-count-distributions.description_zh: 评分数分布，按指定类目及样本展示。

market-seller-country-distributions.description_zh: 卖家国家分布，按指定类目及样本展示。

market-content-distributions.description_zh: 内容配置分布，按指定类目及样本展示。
market-content-distributions.description_en: Content distribution for the specified category sample.

market-top-product-concentrations.description_zh: 商品集中度，按指定类目及样本展示。
market-top-product-concentrations.description_en: Product concentration for the specified category sample.

market-brand-concentrations.description_zh: 品牌集中度，按指定类目及样本展示。

market-seller-concentrations.description_zh: 卖家集中度，按指定类目及样本展示。
market-seller-concentrations.description_en: Seller concentration for the specified category sample.

market-history.description_zh: 市场历史，按指定类目及样本展示。
market-history.description_en: Market history for the specified category sample.

market-discovery.description_zh: 按已确认的条件筛选美国站类目。

market-launch-composition.description_zh: 按首次上架时间查看类目头部商品构成。
